architectural_assertion_a_option.mandate: comp_universe(t) := STR_1715_top_20(t) strict — comp ⊂ 1715 universe by construction (도훈 + Codex C2 mandate)
architectural_assertion_a_option.implementation: build_comp_panel() filters features_master to 1715 top-20 tickers at each sig_date. Stage scorer outputs comp_score for these 20 stocks. K_comp=10 top selected via softmax+min-max+τ=1.0. blend w_final = (1-a_t)·w_1715 + a_t·w_comp → union ≤ 20 by construction.
architectural_assertion_a_option.per_row_assert_strict: stopifnot(nrow(union) <= 20) per sig_date — PASS for all 40 OOS sig_dates × 16 candidates (verified)

g1_p_bad_classifier_oos.diagnosis: Classifier achieves modest AUC discrimination (0.60) and acceptable calibration (Brier 0.22), but bad-state recall fails catastrophically (0.089). At default 0.5 threshold, classifier misses 91% of true bad-state events. Lowering threshold would inflate FPR. Root cause: state-level features (median of universe X_t) are weak proxies for forward 1715-active-return state — informational gap.
remediation_required_before_admit: Threshold-adjusted recall at task-specific operating point (precision/recall trade-off curve)
Alternative bad-state proxy: 1715 holdings cross-sectional features (not universe median)
Multi-task: forecast active return continuous (not binary state)

bad_state_label_selected.selection_rationale: balanced base rate (~20%) + AC-M 2023 RFS empirical bound + matches alpha-research default prior

complement_scorer_4_stage_results.incremental_admission_check_a_option_inv: Under A-option (comp ⊂ 1715), all 4 stages converge to near-identical blend outcomes because they all draw from the same 1715 top-20 universe. Stage incremental gain mostly absent (max ΔSR 0.028 between S1 and S3, all 16 candidates SR cluster 0.505-0.533).

production_admit_vs_canonical_weights_ba.delta_sr_explanation: Production admit SR 1.9536 derives from multi-overlay 5-Layer architecture acting on top of alpha-side weights. The canonical weights.csv represents only the alpha-side; overlay scalars applied at NAV-construction layer, not weights-layer. DPL-RC blend at weights-layer cannot reach overlay-admit SR same-period.
production_admit_vs_canonical_weights_ba.implication: Cross-base comparison invalid (Backtest Contract v1.0 + L-282 PerformanceAnalytics convention drift precedent).
remediation_path: Path A (recommended): re-spec DPL-RC blend at NAV-level: NAV_blend(t) = (1-a_t)·NAV_1715_full_5_layer(t) + a_t·NAV_comp(t). Overlay layers retain on 1715 side only.
Path B: re-spec at weights-level with full 5-Layer overlay re-applied. Requires alpha-research + optimizer-research mandate amendment.
Path C: re-define complement as standalone strategy (not 1715-anchored). Drops architectural A-option constraint.

decision_rationale.primary_blocker_1_g1_fail: p_bad classifier recall 0.089 << 0.60 → bad-state forecast inviable as designed. Alpha-research alpha_package §G1 hard ABORT trigger fires.
decision_rationale.primary_blocker_2_architectural_invarian: A-option (comp ⊂ 1715) mechanistically forces cor ≈ 1.0 (axis_6 FAIL by construction). The architectural fix to address Codex C2 portfolio union ≤ 20 inadvertently eliminates orthogonality.
decision_rationale.primary_blocker_3_baseline_mismatch: Production admit SR 1.95 (5-Layer overlay) ≠ canonical weights SR 0.37/0.68 (alpha-side only). DPL-RC blend at weights-layer cannot reach target SR 1.97 same-period.
decision_rationale.secondary_blocker_drag_axis_3: complement drag 0.13-0.17 SR points (target ≤ 0.05) — small injection (a_max 5-20%) introduces non-trivial drag.
decision_rationale.secondary_blocker_bad_imp_nan: Test window 2020-08~2025-09 has zero bad_state events. Bad-state improvement (axis_4) unmeasurable.
decision_rationale.harvey_threshold_corroboration: Harvey t > 3.0 multiple-testing threshold: 0/5 PASS. No significant alpha against any factor model. DSR-deflated SR 0.34 vs baseline 0.43 → -0.09 deflation-adjusted ΔSR also negative.
